title: Montehue/Quotes
summary:
"You're a prince." 
 - Montehue to Dante Vale (The Legacy of Thor)

"Well, all I can say is it's a good thing I was here." 
 - Montehue to Dante Vale, after fighting off the Frost Minions of Ymir (The Legacy of Thor)

"Yeah, sure… Oh wait, got a museum lecture on Thursday. I can't." 
 - Montehue to Dante Vale, after told to surrender by unnamed Suit 012 (Two Powers Become One)

"It's nice fighting side by side, Dante, but we're still in competition. I'm bringing Mjolnir back and don't you forget it." 
 - Montehue to Dante Vale (Two Powers Become One)

"Life and death situations are good for the heart." 
 - Montehue to Lok Lambert (Two Powers Become One)

"We really must stop meeting like this." 
 - Montehue to Dante Vale (To Be Together)
